entries.title: Luke 20:1
segments: ¶Now it happened on one of those days, as He taught the people in the temple and preached the gospel, [that] the chief priests and the scribes, together with the elders, confronted [Him]

entries.title: Luke 20:2
segments: and spoke to Him, saying, "Tell us, by what authority are You doing these things? Or who is he who gave You this authority?"

entries.title: Luke 20:3
segments: But He answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one thing, and answer Me:

entries.title: Luke 20:4
segments: "The baptism of John--was it from heaven or from men?"

entries.title: Luke 20:5
segments: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

entries.title: Luke 20:6
segments: "But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet."

entries.title: Luke 20:7
segments: So they answered that they did not know where [it was] from.

entries.title: Luke 20:8
segments: And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."

entries.title: Luke 20:9
segments: ¶Then He began to tell the people this parable: "A certain man planted a vineyard, leased it to vinedressers, and went into a far country for a long time.

entries.title: Luke 20:10
segments: "Now at vintage-time he sent a servant to the vinedressers, that they might give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the vinedressers beat him and sent [him] away empty-handed.

entries.title: Luke 20:11
segments: "Again he sent another servant; and they beat him also, treated [him] shamefully, and sent [him] away empty-handed.

entries.title: Luke 20:12
segments: "And again he sent a third; and they wounded him also and cast [him] out.

entries.title: Luke 20:13
segments: "Then the owner of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. Probably they will respect [him] when they see him.'

entries.title: Luke 20:14
segments: "But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, 'This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.'

entries.title: Luke 20:15
segments: "So they cast him out of the vineyard and killed [him]. Therefore what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

entries.title: Luke 20:16
segments: "He will come and destroy those vinedressers and give the vineyard to others." And when they heard [it] they said, "Certainly not!"

entries.title: Luke 20:17
segments: Then He looked at them and said, "What then is this that is written: 'The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone'?

entries.title: Luke 20:18
segments: "Whoever falls on that stone will be broken; but on whomever it falls, it will grind him to powder."

entries.title: Luke 20:19
segments: And the chief priests and the scribes that very hour sought to lay hands on Him, but they feared the people--for they knew He had spoken this parable against them.

entries.title: Luke 20:20
segments: ¶So they watched [Him], and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, that they might seize on His words, in order to deliver Him to the power and the authority of the governor.

entries.title: Luke 20:21
segments: Then they asked Him, saying, "Teacher, we know that You say and teach rightly, and You do not show personal favoritism, but teach the way of God in truth:

entries.title: Luke 20:22
segments: "Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

entries.title: Luke 20:23
segments: But He perceived their craftiness, and said to them, "Why do you test Me?

entries.title: Luke 20:24
segments: "Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?" They answered and said, "Caesar's."

entries.title: Luke 20:25
segments: And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."

entries.title: Luke 20:26
segments: But they could not catch Him in His words in the presence of the people. And they marveled at His answer and kept silent.

entries.title: Luke 20:27
segments: ¶Then some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection, came to [Him] and asked Him,

entries.title: Luke 20:28
segments: saying: "Teacher, Moses wrote to us [that] if a man's brother dies, having a wife, and he dies without children, his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.

entries.title: Luke 20:29
segments: "Now there were seven brothers. And the first took a wife, and died without children.

entries.title: Luke 20:30
segments: "And the second took her as wife, and he died childless.

entries.title: Luke 20:31
segments: "Then the third took her, and in like manner the seven also; and they left no children, and died.

entries.title: Luke 20:32
segments: "Last of all the woman died also.

entries.title: Luke 20:33
segments: "Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife does she become? For all seven had her as wife."

entries.title: Luke 20:34
segments: And Jesus answered and said to them, "The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.

entries.title: Luke 20:35
segments: "But those who are counted worthy to attain that age, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage;

entries.title: Luke 20:36
segments: "nor can they die anymore, for they are equal to the angels and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.

entries.title: Luke 20:37
segments: "But even Moses showed in the [burning] bush [passage] that the dead are raised, when he called the Lord 'the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

entries.title: Luke 20:38
segments: "For He is not the God of the dead but of the living, for all live to Him."

entries.title: Luke 20:39
segments: ¶Then some of the scribes answered and said, "Teacher, You have spoken well."

entries.title: Luke 20:40
segments: But after that they dared not question Him anymore.

entries.title: Luke 20:41
segments: And He said to them, "How can they say that the Christ is the Son of David?

entries.title: Luke 20:42
segments: "Now David himself said in the Book of Psalms: 'The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand,

entries.title: Luke 20:43
segments: Till I make Your enemies Your footstool."'

entries.title: Luke 20:44
segments: "Therefore David calls Him 'Lord'; how is He then his Son?"

entries.title: Luke 20:45
segments: Then, in the hearing of all the people, He said to His disciples,

entries.title: Luke 20:46
segments: "Beware of the scribes, who desire to go around in long robes, love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts,

entries.title: Luke 20:47
segments: "who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation."
